en.headline: Hong Kong backs APEC framework to advance digital trade
en.dek: Director-General of Trade and Industry Aaron Liu said Hong Kong will fully support the newly adopted APEC Trade Digitalisation Cooperation Framework and continue sharing its experience as an international trade centre.
body: Director-General of Trade and Industry Aaron Liu said on Wednesday that Hong Kong fully supports the advancement of digital technologies in international trade.

Speaking on an RTHK programme, Liu noted that the APEC Trade Digitalisation Cooperation Framework — a four-year regional initiative — was adopted by the 21 member economies at last week’s APEC meetings in Shenzhen.

“We will fully support the recently endorsed Apec Trade Digitalisation Cooperation Framework. We will continue to make good use of the Apec platform to share Hong Kong’s experience as an international trade centre and in digital trade, telling the good stories of Hong Kong,” Liu said.

He recalled that when Hong Kong attended an APEC event in Dalian in August, the Trade and Industry Department held two workshops on digital service trade rules and data standards, inviting experts and industry representatives to exchange views.

Liu pointed out that Hong Kong plays a unique role by participating in APEC both as a member economy and as a special administrative region of China. This allows the city not only to keep abreast of the latest international trends but also to take part in formulating cooperation directions on emerging topics such as digital trade and the green economy.

zh.headline: 香港支持APEC貿易數碼化合作框架
zh.dek: 工業貿易署署長廖廣翔表示，香港將全力支持新通過的APEC貿易數碼化合作框架，繼續分享香港作為國際貿易中心的經驗。
body: 工業貿易署署長廖廣翔星期三表示，香港全力支持數碼科技在國際貿易的進步。
廖廣翔在香港電台節目上指出，上星期在深圳舉行的APEC會議上，21個成員經濟體通過了為期四年的「APEC貿易數碼化合作框架」。
他說：「我們將全力支持剛通過的APEC貿易數碼化合作框架。我們會繼續善用APEC平台，分享香港作為國際貿易中心及數碼貿易的經驗，講好香港故事。」
他回顧，香港于今年8月參與大連APEC活動時，工業貿易署曾舉行兩場關於數碼服務貿易規則及數據標準的工作坊，邀請專家及業界代表交流。
廖廣翔指出，香港以成員經濟體及中國特別行政區雙重身份參與APEC，角色獨特，不單能掌握國際最新趨勢，亦可參與製定數碼貿易及綠色經濟等新興議題的合作方向。
